policy: Only sources with a permissive or public-domain licence are used. No private conversations, no personal user data, no scraped paywalled content. No dataset is used as a benchmark-metric source without being listed here.

sources.dataset_name: IITB English-Hindi parallel corpus (distributed via kumardeepak/nmt-anuvada)
sources.license: MIT (repository licence). Upstream IITB corpus is distributed for research use; see 'usage_restrictions'.
processing_steps: per-line NFKC normalisation + whitespace collapse + control-char removal
quality filter (length, alpha ratio, word count, repetition, replacement chars)
exact duplicate removal (blake2b of normalised text)
English capped at 1.15x Hindi to avoid English skew
sources.usage_restrictions: Research and non-commercial use. Derived from public web/news translations collected by IITB; individual upstream segments may carry their own terms. Do not present derived model outputs as IITB output.

sources.license: Public domain books (Project Gutenberg). Compilation distributed via nltk_data.
processing_steps: same normalisation + quality filter as above
sources.usage_restrictions: None beyond the Project Gutenberg header/footer terms (stripped at paragraph level).
sources.used_for: English narrative text for pretraining + tokenizer training

sources.license: Apache-2.0 (CC-BY-4.0 for the underlying TOP data per the repository README)
sources.usage_restrictions: Apache-2.0: attribution required. Underlying data is derived from TOP (task-oriented parsing) utterances.

sources.dataset_name: HDRS Hindi dialogue corpus (Hindi Dialogue Restaurant Search)
processing_steps: convert each dialogue turn into user/assistant messages
sources.usage_restrictions: MIT: attribution required. Restaurant-search dialogues; domain-specific.
sources.usage_note: Only 120 dialogues per split file (360 total) are converted, so that Hindi restaurant dialogues do not dominate the instruction mix.

sources.license: Project licence (see LICENSE); authored by this project, not scraped
processing_steps: replicated per personality mode with the mode system prompt
sources.usage_restrictions: Authored for this project. It is a small behavioural seed set: it teaches format and tone, NOT world knowledge.
sources.used_for: instruction tuning (instruction following, uncertainty, clarification, three modes)

excluded_sources.name: Hugging Face datasets (e.g. IndicCorp, OSCAR, Samanantar)
excluded_sources.reason: huggingface.co is blocked by the host network allowlist in this environment (connection returns 000). Not a licensing problem.

excluded_sources.name: Wikimedia dumps / Project Gutenberg direct download
excluded_sources.reason: dumps.wikimedia.org and www.gutenberg.org are blocked by the same host allowlist.

excluded_sources.name: KartikGarg19/Hindi-Text-Corpus, skmanish/hinglish-conv-dataset
excluded_sources.reason: No licence file in the repository — cannot be used.

excluded_sources.name: Private conversations / user data
excluded_sources.reason: Never used. No personal data was collected for this project.

contamination_control.method: Evaluation probes (evaluation/*.py) are authored separately from every training source; a leakage test (data/validate_data.py) also enforces zero exact-overlap between train/val/test splits.
contamination_control.limitation: No full benchmark-contamination scan was possible because no external benchmark (e.g. a Hindi MMLU-style suite) could be downloaded in this environment.
